headline: Tandem theatre is here! In the name of the Tandem bookclub, THE LIBRARY IS OPEN.
subheadline: In our first edition of the Tandem Theatre, we are going back to the basic: PARIS IS BURNING 🔥
description: Often regarded as one of the most monumental documentary of all time, Paris is Burning chronicles the stories of ballroom culture and houses in the 80s and 90s, in Harlem, New York. Tucked away by mainstream society, Black and Latino queers found each other and created safe spaces for themselves, and ballroom culture would come to influence so much of fashion, music, dance and culture, even 40 years later.
location: Toronto Public Library - Palmerston Branch (560 Palmerston Ave, Toronto, ON M6G 2P7)
